description: This PHP source file defines the class SearchDefsDocumentifier, which converts SugarBean objects into indexable documents using a configurable search framework. It includes methods for parsing search field definitions, caching field mappings, and processing bean data for indexing.

classes.name: SearchDefsDocumentifier
classes.description: A class that converts SugarBean objects into indexable documents based on search definitions, with caching and data parsing functionalities.

methods.name: documentify
methods.description: Converts a SugarBean into a searchable document array, applying field mappings and fixing phone and email data.

methods.name: getFieldsToIndex
methods.description: Retrieves and processes search fields for a module, filtering out unsupported or irrelevant fields.

methods.name: getFieldsToIndexCached
methods.description: Caches and retrieves the search fields for a given module to optimize repeated access.

methods.name: parseBeans
methods.description: Extracts relevant properties from a SugarBean into an array based on specified fields.
